reviews.text: This was my first time using this service. They listened carefully to my requests and took them into consideration, resulting in a very cute finish. They also looked at the texture of my child's fur and made suggestions, which I really appreciated since it was my first time. The finished photos were also very cute, and I would definitely use their services again.

I used their services when my previous dog was alive, and several acquaintances had also used them, so I decided to use them without hesitation. 

It was my first time using their services, but everything went smoothly from booking to finishing. 

The consultation was thorough and I felt at ease leaving my dog ​​in their care, and I was given thorough explanations after the trimming, so I would definitely like to use their services regularly! 

Thank you very much◎

My dog ​​absolutely loves this salon and looks forward to her monthly shampoo. The staff are always so kind, flexible, and attentive. I always make last-minute reservations, either the day before or the day of, but they still do their best to accommodate me. This is a huge help!
I received thorough counseling, the service was quick, and the results were excellent! I would like to visit again.

My dog ​​hates having his nails clipped, so we previously had to go to the vet and it took five people to do it, but
at this salon, just two people, a man and a woman, do it easily, which is really helpful.
I thought the salon was clean and great, but
when I called to make an appointment before we moved, they said, "I think it will be difficult for this dog no matter where we take him, so you should consider options like removing the nails under general anesthesia," and it seemed like they were being a bit rude,
which left me with no choice but to cancel my appointment.
I wish they had treated me differently.
It was my first time, but I was very satisfied with the results as they were so attentive and listened to my various requests! I would definitely like to ask for their help again😊 …

I had my dog ​​groomed and my cat's nails clipped.
The store was clean and the work was done smoothly and beautifully!
They also made suggestions about the cut, which was very helpful!
The staff were also kind, and I'd definitely like to come here again!

I visited for grooming!

They carefully confirmed the cut I wanted, and I was thrilled that the finished result was exactly as I imagined! My dog ​​was able to freely enjoy the free space when I picked him up, and he acted completely normal after we got home, so I think he was stress-free. I would definitely like to use their services again.
I always feel comfortable going there.

I always bring my dog ​​in for a shampoo. The results are great, and all the staff are very kind, so I feel at ease leaving my dog ​​there. My dog ​​is always so happy, so I can tell they treat him with love. They also have a pet hotel, and I wanted a salon where I could leave my dog ​​with peace of mind in case something happened, so I searched around and found this one. I would like to continue using their services in the future.

The pet hotel and grooming services were both excellent!
They let my pet stay in a free-roaming space and sent me lots of photos and videos!
Thank you so much for the adorable grooming!
I would definitely like to use your services again!

The moment I walked in, there was a terrible animal smell, or rather, a strong pet smell. It might have just been a particularly bad day.

After the grooming, the brushing seemed insufficient, because when I got home, hair flew everywhere just from my cat walking a little, and my hands were covered in hair when I petted her. That day, my cat, who has never vomited from hairballs before, threw up a lot.

The price was cheap, but I couldn't see what was going on inside, which made me uneasy, and I don't think I'll be using their services again.

FINE PETS provides very efficient, stress-free, and personalized grooming services.

I also appreciate that they always send me cute photos after grooming!

I highly recommend this pet hotel. They keep pets in a free-roaming area instead of cages, and they send lots of photos and updates, which is very reassuring.

Now it's my pet's favorite place. I'm incredibly grateful to the staff.
